source.note: Generated on this branch with scramblePaperWalletMnemonic while that function still existed, so that restore stays provable after paper wallet creation is retired. This is not taken from a real certificate and has never held funds.
source.walletPhrase: The published BIP39 English vector at index 0, universally recognised as a test phrase.
source.certificatePasswordWords: Nine fixed words chosen arbitrarily. They are not a BIP39 phrase and do not need to be; getScrambledInput only runs PBKDF2 over the string.
source.scrambling: rust-cardano-crypto 0.2.0, which this branch does not bump, so the recorded value pins the implementation that produced the historical certificates.
